notes.title: READY FIGHT!!!
notes.notes: I went ahead and generated voice narration via a speech synthesis engine and modified the resulting wave output with filters to produce some in game voice overs. Implemented in the VS game mode. Set both players to CPU to enjoy an endless battle!

notes.title: March 26th Official Release Day
notes.notes:
Drumpfy Walls releases on March 26th!

Game modes at launch: 

[b]Versus[/b]
"Reds" Vs "Blues", play against a friend in a volleyball style, 3 wins to win the match.

[b]Drumpfy Runner[/b]
Patrol the border as Drumpf, don't run out of calories tho! That border is long.

Drumpf - God King of Mer'ca
